title: Slithering Strangler
move_pattern: Starts with Constrict. Then randomly chooses between Thwack or Lash, both of which loop back to Constrict.
notes: The Slithering Strangler uses Constrict to apply its signature debuff to the player. Thwack provides defensiveness by combining damage with block generation. Lash is a pure damage option. The monster consistently cycles back to Constrict, creating a predictable rhythm punctuated by random attack variations.
